email.title: Email
email.description: Email address for the Roborock account that owns or has access to the vacuum.

password.title: Password
password.description: Roborock account password. Used for password login or as a fallback when no encrypted token is available.

encryptedToken.title: Encrypted Token
encryptedToken.description: Encrypted Roborock session data. This is created and managed by the plugin UI after a successful login.

skipDevices.title: Skip Devices
skipDevices.description: Comma-separated Roborock serial numbers or DUIDs to ignore during discovery.

baseURL.title: Region
baseURL.description: Roborock cloud region endpoint. Choose the region used by your Roborock account.

debugMode.title: Debug Mode
debugMode.description: Write verbose Roborock API, discovery, and transport diagnostics to the Homebridge log.

transientWarningThrottleHours.title: Transient Warning Interval
transientWarningThrottleHours.description: Hours between repeated transient timeout warnings for each vacuum. Use 0 to hide these recurring warnings unless debug logging is enabled.

enableMatter.title: Enable Matter Vacuum
enableMatter.description: Experimental. When running Homebridge 2 with Matter enabled for the Roborock child bridge, also exposes each Roborock as a Matter robotic vacuum cleaner with Service Area room selection for clients that support it. Pairing codes are printed in the Homebridge log. The existing HomeKit fan/switch accessory remains available for backwards compatibility.

cloudOnlyMode.title: Use Roborock Cloud Only
cloudOnlyMode.description: Disables local LAN discovery and local TCP commands for this plugin, routing commands and status polling through Roborock cloud when available. Useful when local LAN connections appear connected but consistently time out. Restart the Roborock child bridge after changing this setting.

preferCloudForMatterCommands.title: Prefer Roborock Cloud for Matter Commands
preferCloudForMatterCommands.description: Sends Matter vacuum commands through the Roborock cloud when cloud transport is connected. This can avoid local LAN command timeouts on some models, such as S8, while keeping the legacy HomeKit accessories unchanged.
